title: Forgotten Apocalypse
description: Forgotten Apocalypse is a hardcore Minecraft survival modpack set in a world destroyed by a mysterious infection.
body:
![Forgotten Apocalypse](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21c9ccf4bfd3daf2f07064d3d8eece7bd7c1bea0.jpeg)

Forgotten Apocalypse is a hardcore Minecraft survival modpack set in a world destroyed by a mysterious infection. Massive abandoned cities, ruined highways, and forgotten military bases cover the landscape. Resources are scarce, dangerous weather threatens your survival, and terrifying creatures roam the wasteland.

Loot abandoned buildings, repair vehicles, build fortified settlements, and uncover the secrets behind the collapse of civilization. Whether you play alone or with friends, every journey beyond your base could be your last.
# Important
To enable the abandoned cities, when creating a new world, go to the More tab, open Cities, and choose the city profile you want before generating the world.

#  **Features**
 
🏙️ Huge abandoned cities
🧟 Enhanced zombies and mutants
🚗 Driveable vehicles
🔫 Guns and survival equipment
🌪️ Dynamic weather and seasons
🏰 Base building and faction warfare
👹 Challenging bosses
🎤 Proximity voice chat
🌎 Completely overhauled world generation

Minecraft Version: 1.20.1
